facts.name: extractor_reads_elaborated_definitions
facts.statement: rust_emit_exports collects @[rust_export] declarations and uses Lean constant bodies, not source-string matching

facts.name: surface_type_check
facts.statement: extracted SurfaceFun bodies are type-checked before Rust emission

facts.name: fixed_width_type_extraction
facts.statement: rust_export extraction recognizes UInt32, UInt64, Int32, Int64, Unit, Option, Except, and closed structures/enums

facts.name: match_lowering
facts.statement: Bool, Option, and simple no-field enum matches lower from elaborated recursor/casesOn forms

facts.name: struct_enum_declarations
facts.statement: SurfaceStruct and SurfaceEnum declarations are emitted before generated Rust functions

facts.name: expected_type_propagation
facts.statement: nested Option and Except constructors are checked with the Rust-facing expected type

facts.name: generic_monomorphization
facts.statement: rust_mono_export registers concrete type instantiations of generic Lean definitions and emits concrete Rust functions

facts.name: compatibility_reporting
facts.statement: unsupported tagged exports are skipped and recorded in a structured compatibility report

facts.name: rust_adapter_owned_rejected
facts.statement: owned Rust values cannot cross the raw FFI boundary

facts.name: result_u32_i32_lowering
facts.statement: Result<u32,i32> lowers to status plus two out parameters
